BLACK LEATHER. CHROME BUCKLES. LIQUID GRAPHITE. REAL WOOD. THE NEW RAM
LARAMIE LIMITED PICKUP REDEFINES THE ELEMENTS OF LUXURY WITH UNRIVALED
CRAFTSMANSHIP. It’s an interior that carries you with the sophisticated style only the designers of a new Ram pickup
could accomplish. Coming soon for Ram 1500 and Ram Heavy Duty 2500/3500 is the new Ram Laramie Limited—featuring
unique touches both inside and out that offer head-turning appeal with serious Ram capability. Inside, look for subtle elegant
refinements, applications of Black leather throughout, a Laramie Limited only six-ring instrumentation cluster and newly
designed upper pillar trim and headliner. All-leather Black Natura Plus seats feature embroidered pinstripe details, embroidered
Ram logo and rear seatback map pockets with polished chrome buckles. A re-imagined state-of-the-art console with a new
premium tambour-style console door (finished in Liquid Graphite and real Argento wood) includes a cell phone/tablet holder,
power outlets, and redesigned cup holders. The new Ram Laramie Limited models. For the deep dive into this remarkable new
luxury pickup, visit us at RAMTRUCKS.COM Interior images shown are 1500 model.

LARAMIE LIMITED
1500, 2500, 3500
STYLE AND SOPHISTICATION THAT SHOW YOU’VE ARRIVED, FROM THE MOMENT
YOU SHOW UP. Whether you’ve chosen your new Ram Laramie Limited in the 1500 weight class or a Heavy Duty
2500/3500 model, this is where the total package melds clout with class. Along with available wheel-to-wheel side
steps in brushed chrome, new Ram Laramie Limited brings forth a bold new grille in front with a Ram centric new tailgate
treatment that leaves no doubt who rules this road. On Ram 1500 Laramie Limited, count on a standard Active-Level™
Four-Corner Air Suspension System; on Ram Laramie Limited 2500/3500, the RamBox® Cargo Management System is
standard on models with SRW and 6'4" bed. Unique six-spoke 20-inch aluminum wheels complete the picture. There’s
always more at RAMTRUCKS.COM

Above: new tailgate design boldly states the Ram Laramie Limited identity (1500 model shown).
Below: badging for the available 6.7-liter Cummins® Turbo Diesel for the Laramie Limited 2500/3500 models.

The beauty is always in the details. New Laramie Limited presence on lower exterior door panels mimics interior door trim. Revised floor mats offer a new
touch, adding a row of interwoven Gray thread to resemble interior wood patterns. The look is new, but the capability is pure Ram truck, all the way.
Properly secure all cargo.
